env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
# GoX-only packages participate in package discovery and normal build commands.
go run .
stdout '^hello 120$'
go run main.gox -- value.gox
stdout '^hello 120$'
go build -o app$GOEXE .
go vet .
go list -f '{{.GoXFiles}} {{.GoXGeneratedFiles}}' .
stdout 'main.gox.*main.go:main.gox'
go test ./...
stdout 'ok.*example/lib'
go test -cover ./lib
stdout 'coverage:'
go list ./...
stdout 'example/lib'
go gox emit main.gox
stdout 'func'

# A source edit invalidates generated source and the native compilation cache.
cp replacement.txt lib/value.gox
go run .
stdout '^hello 121$'

# An inactive GoX file must not be parsed.
go build -tags=unrelated -o app$GOEXE .

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.26

 fmt.Println(F"hello {do int {return fact(5)+lib.Offset()}}")
}
